Aliases.description: Optional parameter for declaring alias names when doing a person search (seperated by commas)

DOB.description: Optional parameter for date of birth name when doing a person search

FamilyName.description: Optional parameter for last name when doing a person search

Filters.description: Optional parameter for restricting search when doing a person search (seperated by commas)

GivenName.description: Optional parameter for first name when doing a person search

LEI.description: Optional Legal Entity Identifier for additional business identifier verification.

Locale.description: Optional name of City or Locale to assist in identifying matches based upon location/geography.

Medialists.description: Optional parameter for selecting only specific media lists. By default all lists are queried

MiddleName.description: Optional parameter for middle name when doing a person search

Monitoring.description: If this Pep Sanction Check should be continuesly monitored.

Peplists.description: Optional parameter for selecting only specific pep lists. By default all lists are queried

Region.description: Optional name of Region or State to assist in identifying matches based upon location/geography.

SmartMatch.description: Optional parameter for enabling SmartMatch to retrieve more results

Watchlists.description: Optional parameter for selecting only specific watch lists. By default all lists are queried

Webhook.description: If Monitoring is enabled this parameter is required. This is where updates will be sent to
